# FLX-3615: consumers limits.memory is above the engine's ceiling

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A bundle may only lower the memory a query may use: limits.memory is at most 1GiB, the engine's ceiling, and a bundle that asks for more is refused by every command. The command-line flag --max-query-memory raises the ceiling to at most 16GiB for the command that runs the queries, for a bundle that declares no limits.memory of its own.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3615
```
